notes: Spell builds can now cast a spell twice in a row before switching (for example Arrow Bomb, Arrow Bomb, Escape), using the repeat rule you tested in game: the second cast in a row costs the same, a third would cost 5 more mana, and the spell right after a double costs 5 more. "How to play" tells you the exact order. Crafted builds also got better: each extra search now hands on its next-best builds too, and crafted items are also designed for builds on other ability trees. In our tests: Archer Trapper spells +20%, Assassin level 55 spells +28%, Assassin level 50 balanced +14%, Warrior level 50 melee +10%; nothing got worse. Searches where spells count take a bit longer.
